title: Loan Servicing Desk Note — Farm Real Estate and Equipment Installments Funded through a Class H Preferred Stock Redemption, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The redemption installment addition lets a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock redemption fund an installment the member owes the association in the quarter. The current quarter runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.

## Rule

- When the member's active farm real estate loan (Farm Real Estate Loans) has its next installment due inside the current quarter, the addition is that installment amount.
- When no farm real estate installment is due inside the quarter but the member's active equipment loan (Equipment & Vehicle Loans) has its next installment due inside it, the addition is that equipment installment amount.
- Otherwise there is no addition.

The addition is a dollar amount added to the quarter's redemption allowance on the holding, before the allowance is rounded half up to the cent, once, on its final figure.

## Records read

- From Farm Real Estate Loans: the loan's status (active), its next due date and its installment amount.
- From Equipment & Vehicle Loans: the loan's status (active), its next due date and its installment amount.
- **Inside the current quarter**: a next due date on or after 1 July 2026 and on or before 30 September 2026.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

| Farm real estate loan | Equipment loan | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| Active, next installment USD 18,400.00 due 1 August 2026 | Active, next installment USD 6,200.00 due 15 September 2026 | USD 18,400.00 — the farm real estate installment |
| Active, next installment due 1 January 2027 | Active, next installment USD 6,200.00 due 15 September 2026 | USD 6,200.00 — the equipment installment |
| None | Active, next installment due 15 October 2026 | None |
| None | None | None |
